svg.text: S3 DENSE BELTS — docked belt levels
Boxes stand on 13 motor-less belt levels, 2 rows deep. A lift in the front aisle docks at a level and drives its belt.
worst case 18.4 s · mean ≈ 8 s · parts ≈ €2,260
TOP VIEW of level 8 (front at the bottom)

g.text: aisle: lift is at another level

svg.text: x 650 wide · rows: S 108, M 162, L 325 side by side
Every level is a passive belt conveyor carrying 2 rows of boxes.
The lift carries a short belt. Docked, its blade turns the level roller,
so ONE motor moves the lift belt and the level belt together.
A whole row moves at once; the transport picks one box from above.
A box in the back row first needs its front row parked elsewhere.

g.text: 1/6 The lift waits empty at the top exit. Wanted: a box in the front row of level 8
2/6 The lift drops to level 8; its blade slides through the open slots of the levels it passes
3/6 Docked: one motor turns lift belt and level belt together — the front row rides onto the lift
4/6 The lift rises to the exit; its last 30 mm push the shutter open
5/6 The transport reaches down through the port and lifts the wanted box out
6/6 The lift pushes the rest of the row back into level 8 and returns to the top
